# Icon picker (`icon-picker`)

Pick an icon from a grid.

Group: Pickers. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/pickers';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIconPicker` (types in `dist/web/pickers/iconPicker.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-picker`: an optional search box over a grid of icons (`role="listbox"`, each `.mh-icon-picker__option` a `role="option"` with `aria-selected`). Arrow keys move in two dimensions, Home and End to the ends, typing in the search filters, Enter or Space picks. Defaults to the built-in icon set; pass `icons` for your own.

```ts
export function createIconPicker(options: IconPickerOptions = {}): IconPickerHandle;

export interface IconPickerOptions {
  /** The icons to offer: built-in names or items with their own paths. Default: every built-in icon. */
  icons?: readonly (string | IconPickerItem)[];
  value?: string | null;
  /** Shows a search box (default: when there are more than twelve icons). */
  search?: boolean;
  /** Adds a "No icon" choice first. */
  allowNone?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the list (default "Icon"). */
  label?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (name: string | null) => void;
}

export interface IconPickerHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  listbox: HTMLDivElement;
  search: SearchFieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): string | null;
  setValue(name: string | null): void;
  /** Filters the grid as the search box does. */
  filter(query: string): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface IconPickerItem {
  /** The value reported when picked, e.g. `lightbulb`. */
  name: string;
  /** SVG path data (24×24); default the built-in icon of that name. */
  path?: string;
  /** Spoken and shown on hover (default the name in words: `arrow-left` → "Arrow left"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Extra words the search matches. */
  keywords?: readonly string[];
}

export interface SearchFieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  clearButton: HTMLButtonElement;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`iconLabel` (types in `dist/web/pickers/iconPicker.d.ts`): "arrow-left" → "Arrow left".

```ts
export function iconLabel(name: string): string;
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiBed, mdiGarage, mdiSofaOutline, mdiStove } from '@mdi/js';
import { createIconPicker, iconLabel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const picker = createIconPicker({
  label: 'Room icon',
  value: 'sofa',
  allowNone: true,
  icons: [
    { name: 'sofa', path: mdiSofaOutline, label: 'Living room', keywords: ['lounge'] },
    { name: 'bed', path: mdiBed, label: 'Bedroom', keywords: ['sleep'] },
    { name: 'kitchen', path: mdiStove, label: 'Kitchen', keywords: ['cook'] },
    { name: 'garage', path: mdiGarage, label: 'Garage', keywords: ['car'] },
    'lightbulb',
    'fan',
  ],
  onChange: (name) => (status.textContent = name ? `Picked ${iconLabel(name)}.` : 'No icon.'),
});

document.body.append(picker.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiBed, mdiGarage, mdiSofaOutline, mdiStove } from '@mdi/js';
import { IconPicker } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { iconLabel, type IconPickerItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const roomIcons: (string | IconPickerItem)[] = [
  { name: 'sofa', path: mdiSofaOutline, label: 'Living room', keywords: ['lounge'] },
  { name: 'bed', path: mdiBed, label: 'Bedroom', keywords: ['sleep'] },
  { name: 'kitchen', path: mdiStove, label: 'Kitchen', keywords: ['cook'] },
  { name: 'garage', path: mdiGarage, label: 'Garage', keywords: ['car'] },
  'lightbulb',
  'fan',
];

export function IconPickerExample() {
  const [icon, setIcon] = useState<string | null>('sofa');
  return (
    <>
      <IconPicker label="Room icon" allowNone icons={roomIcons} value={icon} onChange={setIcon} />
      <p>{icon ? `Picked ${iconLabel(icon)}.` : 'No icon.'}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
